Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: In the final analysis step (Step 10), the Planner incorrectly stated that Sebastián Borensztein was born in 1927. The WebSurfer had just successfully retrieved the correct birth date of April 22, 1963 from Wikipedia. The Planner likely hallucinated the year 1927 (possibly confusing it with another historical figure or misreading the data) and drew the wrong conclusion that Borensztein was born earlier than Ela Gandhi (1940), when in fact he was born later (1963).
